description: Synthetic verbatim quotes spoken by the child, each with speaker attribution and a preserved source snippet. quoteText is the exact words; sourceQuote is the exact raw source text they came from — both stay verbatim.

items.statement: Car-seat astronomy at dusk on the way home from grandma's.
items.quoteText: The moon is following our car. It loves us.
items.sourceQuote: From the back seat, completely serious: 'The moon is following our car. It loves us.'

items.statement: Delivered solemnly at breakfast — the family's benchmark for when to stop singing.
items.sourceQuote: 'Dada, your singing is broken.' — she waited for me to stop before adding 'again.'
